name: Reijuu no Acolyte Lufia
original_name: 隷従の聖侍祭 ルフィア
source:
A story about a pure-hearted elf girl who struggles to stay strong despite being defiled by worldly desires.

The orphaned elf girl Lufia is taken in by the church. Outwardly, she serves as an acolyte of the church; behind the scenes, she provides services in return for donations. Under the false pretense of "offering herself to god," Lufia is trained to serve as comfort for so-called benefactors. Day by day, she bravely fulfills her duties with her own body.

Leane, a senpai who has long served the church, is a half dark elf and half human. Though she was initially harsh toward Lufia when they first met, her compassion for Lufia's situation eventually wins out, and she begins to look after her.

Day after day, the two of them carry on their service, answering the church's demands. Before long, word of the "elf servants" spreads, bringing in many benefactors. The days of bearing countless desires upon their bodies continue with no end in sight...

[Translated from the [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/lufia/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
讲述了一个心地纯洁的精灵女孩在被世俗欲望玷污后仍努力坚强的故事。

孤儿精灵少女露菲亚被教会收留。表面上，她是教会的助手；实际上，她是教会的助手。她在幕后提供服务以换取捐款。在“将自己奉献给上帝”的虚假借口下，露菲亚被训练为所谓的恩人提供安慰。日复一日，她用自己的身体勇敢地履行着自己的职责。

莉恩是一位长期为教会服务的前辈，她是一半黑暗精灵一半人类的血统。虽然他们第一次见面时她最初对露菲亚很严厉，但她对露菲亚处境的同情最终胜出，并开始照顾她。

日复一日，两人继续服务，回应教会的要求。不久，“精灵仆人”的消息传开，带来了许多恩人。身上承载着无数欲望的日子还在继续，看不到尽头……

[翻译自[url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/lufia/#story]官网[/url]]
